text:
maria: quick sanity check — i'm about to land a tf change that moves the ledger service into the prod overlay namespace 'ledger-prod' and switches the KMS key to customer-managed. small PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123. does this look safe for promote later today?

devon: can you paste the terraform diff? worried about iam binding ordering and sa token mounts.

maria: diff snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "ledger" {
  description = "ledger prod key"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
}
resource "aws_kms_alias" "ledger_alias" {
  name = "alias/ledger-prod"
  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.ledger.id
}
module "k8s_overlay" { ... }
```
I also add `kubernetes_service_account` annotation for `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` to new sa.

sam: double-check the secrets path for ledger-api creds — are we moving from /secrets/ledger/ to /prod/ledger/? If so need a migration step in the promote.

maria: yes, plan is to copy secret to `prod/ledger/credentials` via a one-off script, then update overlay refs. plan attached in PR description.

jen: @maria will the pod restart require any downtime? If the SA annotation changes it will trigger new tokens.

maria: should be rolling. k8s podtemplate unchanged except sa annotation; rollout should be fine because the replicas > 2, canary first.

devon: watch for race between KMS key creation and alias — TF tries to create alias after key; but key ARN changes cause IAM conditions. recommend add `depends_on = [aws_kms_key.ledger]` on alias and add lifecycle ignore_changes for `deletion_window_in_days` maybe.

maria: good call. i'll update.

deploy-bot: PR 4123 — plan successful in staging. canary deploy queued. :white_check_mark:

aaron: small FYI — ensure S3 artifact encryption config references the new key id; we had a missed reference last time.

maria: added acceptance test to overlay e2e: `make e2e-promote TARGET=ledger` — will run in CI.

sam: ok — i'll 👀 during promote. if nobody objects we can promote at 15:30 UTC.

devon: ack from me, just update alias depends_on.

jen: ack

maria: thanks team :rocket:
